name: Jehud
title: Descendants of Manasseh
summary: Jehud is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles 7:18 as the son of Hammoleketh (his sister), a woman from the tribe of Manasseh. He is only mentioned in genealogies and has no further narrative role in the Bible. His significance lies in being part of the tribal register of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Jehud is mentioned as the son of Hammoleketh in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh. He is listed together with his brothers Abiezer and Mahlah.
